title: Range check on an expression that cancels to zero

request.goal: What does calculate("1e13 - 1e13") return or raise? If it raises, give the MeshError code.

code.title: scripts/atomic_mesh.py excerpt (calculate)

pass: It raises MeshError('arithmetic_out_of_range'): each constant is range-checked as soon as it is visited, and 1e13 exceeds 1e12 before the subtraction happens.
fail: It raises invalid_numeric_literal because 1e13 is a float.
